limitations: The exact transaction and negotiation path are supported by canonical data and stored contemporary negotiation history, while the three-pick control strategy is reconstructed from Robert's 2026 recollection.
Robert is very confident that controlling 7.01-7.03 was the plan; he is somewhat less certain that Kenneth Walker was already the specifically designated 7.03 target before execution.
The individual Marcel-trade decision confidence, outcome uncertainty and perceived price relative to a hard ceiling have not yet been separately calibrated.
Later player performance is excluded from the ex-ante reconstruction.

evidence_basis.note: Confirms completed TeamID 1 ↔ TeamID 2 transaction and exact original startup-pick identities.

Distilled from the contemporary WhatsApp export: Robert targeted 7.03 within a concentrated target window; Marcel opened at 7.03 for 8.05 + 9.02; Robert requested a late pick back; Marcel countered with 12.04; Robert accepted.

Robert remembers the two 28 Aug trades as one coordinated maneuver whose appeal was controlling three consecutive picks 7.01-7.03. He remembers the intended cluster as two top tight ends plus Kenneth Walker, with Walker specifically in mind for the third controlled pick, though this player-specific memory is slightly less certain than the overall control strategy.
The 2024 league configuration had two dedicated TE starting slots, supporting the broader target-cluster strategy around two TEs plus a third priority player.

decision_context.objective: Acquire 7.03 as the closing piece of a coordinated 7.01-7.03 control block, preserving a late return pick while creating room for two targeted TEs plus a third priority target Robert remembers as Kenneth Walker.
decision_context.roster_context: The startup draft was in progress. Robert's broader plan was to use three consecutive controlled picks to establish both dedicated TE starting spots with high-end options and add another priority player in the same window.
decision_context.cap_salary_context: No contemporaneous salary or cap rationale is preserved in the currently available evidence and none is used in this reconstruction.
decision_context.team_window: This was foundational startup roster construction, with Robert prioritizing control and positional certainty over retaining more picks in the immediately following rounds.
decision_context.market_context: Marcel's opening price was 7.03 for 8.05 + 9.02. Robert sought a late pick back and accepted 12.04. Only 2 minutes 28 seconds later Robert completed the Tim 7.01 trade, strongly supporting that the negotiations were parts of one coordinated draft maneuver.
decision_context.why_now: Robert wanted to control all three consecutive selections 7.01-7.03 before the target window passed. The Marcel trade supplied the final 7.03 slot while Robert already owned 7.02 and was simultaneously negotiating for 7.01.
constraints: Robert wanted a late selection returned rather than surrendering all later draft volume in the Marcel move.
The Marcel construction had to coexist with the simultaneous Tim negotiation, where Robert explicitly protected the 9th-round pick because it was already involved here.
The strategy concentrated multiple later assets into immediate draft control.

theses.statement: Acquiring 7.03 was worth moving 8.05 and 9.02 because it completed a three-consecutive-pick control block in Robert's priority target window.
falsification_conditions: The target cluster would have remained reliably available through Robert's original 8.05/9.02 positions.
Owning 7.03 did not materially improve Robert's ability to execute the intended three-pick sequence.

theses.statement: The broader 7.01-7.03 strategy was designed to secure two top tight ends plus a third priority player that Robert remembers as Kenneth Walker.
falsification_conditions: Kenneth Walker was not actually part of Robert's intended target cluster before the trade.
The third controlled pick was opportunistic rather than part of the pre-trade plan.

theses.statement: Receiving 12.04 back preserved enough later selection optionality to make the 7.03 consolidation structure more acceptable.
falsification_conditions: The returned late selection had negligible value to Robert at the time.
Robert would have accepted Marcel's opening construction just as readily without any return pick.

alternatives.description: Accept Marcel's opening 7.03 for 8.05 + 9.02 with no pick returned.
alternatives.reason_not_chosen: Robert asked for a late selection back rather than accepting the opening construction unchanged.

alternatives.description: Receive 11.03 back as the late return asset.
alternatives.reason_not_chosen: Robert requested this return, but Marcel countered with 12.04 instead.

price_ceiling.description: No explicit hard ceiling survives in the available contemporary evidence beyond Robert's willingness to execute the final 7.03 + 12.04 for 8.05 + 9.02 construction.

decision_state_at_execution.confidence_rationale: The combined three-pick control strategy is now well supported by Robert's recollection and the near-simultaneous negotiations, but Robert has not yet separately calibrated his confidence in the Marcel 7.03 component itself.
decision_state_at_execution.primary_confidence_driver: Completing control of the 7.01-7.03 target window while receiving a late pick back.
decision_state_at_execution.primary_source_of_doubt: The individual Marcel-trade confidence and price perception are not yet separately remembered with enough precision to score.
known_personal_biases: Preference for controlling a desired draft window and reducing target uncertainty.

portfolio_links.description: Executed 2 minutes 28 seconds before the Tim trade. Together with Robert's own 7.02, the two deals created control of 7.01-7.03 for one coordinated startup target-window strategy.
